questions.prompt: A raw chicken tray is dripping onto the vegetables in the fridge. What do you do?
Ten orders come in at once during the lunch rush. How do you keep up?
You notice the chopping boards were not cleaned after the morning shift. What do you do?

entries.answer: I throw away the vegetables the juice touched, move the chicken to the bottom shelf in a covered tray, and clean the shelf with sanitiser. I wash my hands after. Then I tell the chef what happened so he knows those vegetables are gone.
I will work fast and ask other helpers to help me.
No time, I will just wipe them with a cloth and use them.
First i will see which order is first and prepare that. Onion tomato cutting i will do ready before. I will tell chef sir which orders are ready.
Clean, wash, hygiene, gloves, team, chef.

First I wash my hands and wear gloves. I take out the vegetables that got the chicken juice and throw them away. I clean the fridge shelf with hot soapy water and sanitiser, put the chicken in a closed container on the lowest shelf, and label it. I inform the chef so we can reorder vegetables.
I will wipe the vegetables and keep them back.
I will clean the fridge and tell the chef.
Bin anything that got the drips on it, scrub the shelf down, and shift the meat underneath in a sealed box. Let the head cook know.
Clean it.

I check all the tickets and plan which dishes take longest so I start those first. I keep my station organised and prep the common items like onions and sauces together. I tell the chef which orders are ready and ask a colleague to help with plating if needed.
I will do my best and work hard.
Line the tickets up, knock out the slow-cooking stuff first and batch the chopping. Shout out to the chef when plates are good to go, and grab a hand from whoever's free.
I worked in a hotel in Goa for two years.
Fast, plan, prep, organize, team, chef, time.

I don't use them like that. I wash the boards with hot soapy water, sanitise them and let them dry, using separate boards for raw meat and vegetables. I tell the supervisor so the morning team knows, and I check the boards are clean before my shift ends.
I will wash the boards and use them.
I will wash all board properly with soap and hot water. Then i will tell to supervisor that morning shift not cleaned.
I wouldn't complain or fight with the morning staff. I'd just clean them properly and tell the chef so it's fixed for next time.
Use another board.
